metric_scope.pilot_horizon: 128 attempts; original reports retained with model_edges_128_ prefix
metric_scope.atomic_metrics: On each controller's own first-visit states, not a shared model-independent question cohort.
metric_scope.brier: Scalar Bernoulli squared error, not two-class summed Brier.
metric_scope.constant_control: p(true)=0.5 for every local proposition; the same deterministic exploration code still selects actions.
metric_scope.reference_control: Perfect local geometry predictions with the same exploration policy; no full-map BFS route.
metric_scope.failure_handling: Every selected episode is retained; missing or invalid sources are never assigned fabricated outcomes.
